title: valeriana scandens var. genuina
intro: Valeriana scandens var. genuina, commonly known as Valerian Creeper, is a flowering plant species within the family Valerianaceae. It is primarily recognized for its therapeutic properties and health benefits, which include relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness. The therapeutic actions of Valerian Creeper are attributed to its sedative, anxiolytic, and spasmolytic effects, which are often utilized in herbal medicine to promote relaxation and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including valepotriates, isovaltrate, and valepin, contribute to its therapeutic actions, although more research is needed to fully understand the scope of its benefits and applications.
